A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same SureLock study, with corresponding main sections and complete appendices. Text, equations, tables, extracted figure labels and embedded graphics support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original LLaDA-8B experiments measuring computational cost, throughput and generation quality on WikiText-103, MT-Bench and HumanEval (Section 3 and Appendix J).

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and their results, including the supplementary analyses and HumanEval evaluation.

M1.justification: Section 2 and Algorithm 1 retain the same KL-based locking, optional confidence gate, K/V caching and computation skipping. Appendix M's optional unlocking procedure is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same WikiText-103 continuation, MT-Bench instruction-following and HumanEval code-generation tasks. No dataset, domain or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The comparisons retain the same sampler without locking. Experiment 5/Table 4 also retains the fixed-fraction selection surrogate with k=0.8 and its combination with SureLock; comparator membership is unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 3 and Appendices G–K retain the same prompt subsets, preprocessing, model configurations, generation lengths, step counts, batch sizes, thresholds and evaluation metrics. No evaluation protocol is revised.

E4.justification: The KL-dynamics investigation in Appendix C, confidence-gate sensitivity in Appendix H, threshold sweep in Experiment 6 and qualitative examples in Appendix N retain the same analyses and evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates and averages without experimental repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. Uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–6, plotted results and decoded examples are unchanged. For example, Table 6 retains HumanEval Pass@1 of 18.6 for the baseline and 20.3/18.6 for SureLock at thresholds 5e-4/5e-3, respectively.

T1.justification: Theorem 1, assumptions A1–A4, the terminal log-probability error bound, Appendix D's derivations and Appendix M's formal unlocking discussion are unchanged.

C1.justification: Both retain the same central contributions: permanently skipping computation for converged tokens, theoretical justification through local KL, and claimed 30–50% algorithmic FLOP reductions with comparable generation quality.

C2.justification: The interpretations and qualifications concerning short-generation quality, semantic stability, idealized theoretical assumptions, sampling temperature and implementation overhead remain unchanged in the main text and appendices.

D1.justification: v1's abstract and Reproducibility Statement promise release of the experimental code. v3 replaces these promises with general project-page availability/details statements at the same URL. Other technical disclosures remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish whether actual code availability changed.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Shortening Chen et al.'s author list and reformatting the Chen and Nie references are bibliographic edits, not additions or removals of related work.

P1.justification: Limited edits revise Figure 1's caption, the abstract's closing sentence and the Reproducibility Statement. Publication headers and reference formatting are updated, while the main narrative, section order and appendix structure remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 revises Figure 1's caption and introduces colored citation, cross-reference and URL text, with minor paragraph and bibliography reflow. The figures, tables and underlying graphical contents are retained.

improvement.justification: The scientific method, theory, evidence and conclusions are unchanged. Caption and link-formatting edits provide modest polish, while removing the explicit code-release promise makes release plans less clear. With technical details retained and no demonstrated change in actual code access, these limited edits do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
